propositions: Unit test test_a_missing_epic_field_aborts_provisioning stubs /rest/api/2/field to omit Epic Link, causing the readiness poll to expire against the full 120-second production budget instead of failing fast.
The test runs ~120 stub reads and sleeps ~120 real seconds (120.38s measured) because await_required_fields loops on the 120s budget at 1s intervals until timeout.
Setting JIRA_DC_FIELD_READY_TIMEOUT environment variable to 0 makes the readiness loop deterministic: exactly one poll attempt before breaking, with no sleep calls.
With zero budget the test completes in <0.005s and asserts exactly one field read, proving expiry occurred without sleep, replacing timing-budget checks with logical-count assertions.
Production code already honors the JIRA_DC_FIELD_READY_TIMEOUT env var in _field_ready_timeout, making this seam available without changing production signatures or constants.
